title: Piercing Statue Trio #003 (데미스탯 · [데미스탯·P25 집중형·purpleheart·메이크업 홍콩풍] ; [데미스탯·P25 집중형·purpleheart·메이크업 히메갸루] ; [데미스탯·P8 집중형·수조·장미 정원·메이크업 페르시안글램])
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, demi statue portrait. THREE women standing side by side, each angled 45 degrees toward the camera, framed so every woman's whole sculpted form is visible from the top of her head down to two individually rounded, deliberately carved tips a little further below the middle of her thighs, each face in natural scale with her body — never an oversized close-up crop. Where a sculpted form comes to an end at the thighs, it is because the sculpture itself ends there, not because a camera frame happens to cut her off. Generous spacing so every figure reads clearly, nobody's arms crossing a neighbour.

#1: A strikingly beautiful adult Chinese woman — fair matte skin with a soft powdery finish, thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge, a poised, glamorous expression, soft rose-gold hair styled in cornrows braided tight against the scalp. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#1 Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight oversized pieces — a huge silver segment ring hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide silver ear cuff, three smaller silver rings, two thick silver bars and a small silver stud up to the top; one small silver stud sits in the right ear; four thin silver bars pass through the outer half of the left eyebrow; two small silver rings pass through the left nostril and a thick silver septum ring hangs below the nose; a silver hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a silver snake-bite ring beside it and a small silver ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a silver Medusa stud sits above the lips; a silver labret stud and a small silver ring sit on the chin; three small silver studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small mixed gemstones (diamond, pearl, opal, amethyst, ruby and sapphire) set into alternating pieces.
#1 Physique: A giant hourglass frame flaring at both ends — broad shoulders, a colossal chest projecting past them, a big round belly, hips as broad as the shoulders, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped.
#1 Body: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both distinct thighs — is not painted, covered or clothed but physically made of one solid opaque wood, solid deep violet purpleheart wood, a dense hardwood of rich purple with fine straight grain, polished to a hard satin sheen, completely opaque, carved as one solid sculpted mass like a statue, never hollow, with no seam and no skin anywhere, every wrist, palm, finger and knuckle the same material. A little further below the middle of her thighs, each thigh individually curves inward and rounded off into its own smooth, deeply polished tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip. Her body below the collarbones is a completely opaque solid that no light passes through; her face, ears and neck are living flesh.

#2: A strikingly beautiful adult Japanese woman — fair porcelain skin, soft pink blush across the cheeks, sparkling pink eyeshadow, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy candy-pink lips, a sweet princess-like smile, warm chestnut-brown hair styled in high ponytail. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#2 Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight oversized pieces — a huge mixed-metal bar hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide mixed-metal ear cuff, three smaller mixed-metal rings, two thick mixed-metal bars and a small mixed-metal stud up to the top; one small mixed-metal stud sits in the right ear; four thin mixed-metal bars pass through the outer half of the left eyebrow; two small mixed-metal rings pass through the left nostril and a thick mixed-metal septum ring hangs below the nose; a mixed-metal hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a mixed-metal snake-bite ring beside it and a small mixed-metal ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a mixed-metal Medusa stud sits above the lips; a mixed-metal labret stud and a small mixed-metal ring sit on the chin; three small mixed-metal studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small rubies set into the metal.
#2 Physique: A giant hourglass frame flaring at both ends — broad shoulders, a colossal chest projecting past them, a big round belly, hips as broad as the shoulders, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped.
#2 Body: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both distinct thighs — is not painted, covered or clothed but physically made of one solid opaque wood, solid deep violet purpleheart wood, a dense hardwood of rich purple with fine straight grain, polished to a hard satin sheen, completely opaque, carved as one solid sculpted mass like a statue, never hollow, with no seam and no skin anywhere, every wrist, palm, finger and knuckle the same material. A little further below the middle of her thighs, each thigh individually curves inward and rounded off into its own smooth, deeply polished tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip. Her body below the collarbones is a completely opaque solid that no light passes through; her face, ears and neck are living flesh.

#3: A strikingly beautiful adult Iranian woman — richly kohl-lined almond eyes, a deep berry-red lip, thick dark brows, warm olive skin, cool ash-brown hair styled in two small space buns on top of the head. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain, real living eyes with bright catchlights and genuine depth, individual hair strands catching the light.
#3 Piercings: All eight piercings gather on the left side of her face and ear, and the right side stays bare: on the left ear five pieces — a huge antique-brass clicker ring hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide antique-brass ear cuff, two smaller antique-brass rings and a small antique-brass stud at the top; two thin antique-brass bars pass through the outer end of the left eyebrow; a small antique-brass ring passes through the left nostril. Each piece carries small opals set into the metal.
#3 Physique: A colossal, statuesque chest, a broad heavy torso and wide statuesque hips, both thighs clearly separate and individually shaped, all on a grand imperial scale.
#3 Body: From the collarbones down, her whole body — shoulders, arms, hands, chest, belly, hips and both distinct thighs — is a sculpted vessel of thick, crystal-clear glass in the exact shape of her body, filled completely to the brim so nothing is hollow and there is no air gap. The glass is unmistakably glass: thick, crystal-clear and polished, with bright specular reflections sliding along every curved surface, sharp white highlights and dark refraction edges where the walls are thickest, tiny bubbles trapped in the glass itself. Her shoulders, chest, belly, hips and both thighs keep their exact sculpted shapes as clear glass outlines, and a clean glass rim runs along the boundary where the vessel meets the neck. The vessel holds ONE single world, unbroken and continuous through her whole chest, belly, hips and both thighs, with no split, no second world and no change of contents anywhere: a rose garden at dawn: red and white roses among dark green leaves, a few drifting petals, standing in the clear water that fills her body, denser near the chest and thinning toward the thighs. A little further below the middle of her thighs, each thigh individually curves inward and sealed shut into its own smooth, rounded, closed tip — the two thighs stay clearly separate, never merging into a single base — nothing continues below either tip. Her body below the collarbones is a transparent material that light passes through; her face, ears and neck stay opaque living flesh.

All piercings: All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Boundary for each woman: a sharp jagged line runs around the base of her neck and across both collarbones — real skin above, material immediately below. At that line, the material's edge rises in a small raised step above her flesh, casting a crisp shadow — her skin beside it stays smooth and even. Each rounded tip is that material's own carved finish — never the edge of a photograph. Shards interlock along the collarbone line only.

Setting: a huge backdrop behind them washed with two coloured lights from behind — a soft teal on one side and a pale sea-green on the other, blending into a smooth gradient in the middle, and a glossy dark floor beneath them.

Pose: each stands tall, her left hand resting on her flared hip, her right arm held clear of her body with the hand relaxed at hip height, every hand well away from every face, heads tilted slightly toward the camera.

Lighting: the glowing backdrop floods every transparent body from behind, tinting it, while the opaque bodies block it completely and are lit by two large softboxes raking from either side. A soft frontal light falls on all the faces and ears; a thin cool rim light traces every figure. Only each woman's face, ears and neck read as real skin. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field. 4:5 aspect ratio, 8K.
